info.title: API
info.description: Generated from web/src/contracts/api.ts — do not edit. Conventions: docs/eng/api.md.

get.summary: Who is signed in. `unauthorized` means nobody, which is an answer and not a fault.

post.summary: Emails a 6-digit code. Always 204, so the endpoint cannot be used to probe accounts.
Trades the emailed code for a session; the account is created on its first sign-in.
Trades a Google ID token for a session. `unauthorized` when Google rejects the token.
Ends the session. 204 whether or not there was one.

get.summary: The account as its owner edits it.

patch.summary: Changes the fields sent and answers the whole profile.

delete.summary: Deletes the account (the stores require it in-app; decision #28). Its active cases are closed, what it contributed to others’ cases stays anonymous, its interests and offers are withdrawn, its inbox, devices and conversations are erased, and the session ends.

post.summary: Sends the 6-digit SMS code to a new number, outside a publish. The number is not changed until `verifyPhoneChange`. Rate-limited like every SMS (auth.md · Phone).
Checks the code and makes the number the account’s verified one. Answers the whole profile. Cases already published keep the number they were published with.
Registers this install for push. Registering the same token again is not an error.
Publishes an adoption listing, with the same phone step as every publish. With `from_found_case_code` it is the day-15 conversion of the caller’s found case: same pet, the found case `converted`.

«Me interesa»: the intro row first, then the channels the lister enabled. One per person per listing — asking again answers the same row (a withdrawn one comes back open). Needs a verified number, with the publish phone step.
«Ya no me interesa»: one tap, and the interest leaves the lister’s list.
The lister marks an interest chosen («En proceso» in public, one at a time), declines it (silent to the adopter) or puts it back on the list («No se concretó»).
«¿Quién lo adoptó?»: an interest (`adopted_in_app` — the responsibility moves to that person) or nobody on the platform (`adopted_offline`). Ends the listing.
Takes an adoption listing down, with its reason. Pet and lister link are untouched.

get.summary: The zone this account asked to be told about, and whether it is on.

post.summary: Sets the zone and turns the alerts on or off. On needs a `center` (`validation_failed` without one). Off keeps the zone. Answers the whole setting.

get.summary: The «Mensajes» tab: this account’s conversations, newest message first, closed ones last. Names come as the other person shows them (first name and initial); never a number.
One thread with its messages, oldest first, and the case card. Only its two participants.

post.summary: A text message. A closed conversation is read-only and final: `invalid_transition`. The other side gets a push, never the text of a number.
Marks what the other person wrote as read: opening the thread does it.
«Dar mi WhatsApp»: puts this account’s verified number on the thread, once, as a message the other side can open. An account without a verified number answers `phone_required`.

«Escribir por chat»: writes the first message to whoever answers for the case — its publisher, custodian or lister — and creates the conversation with it, never on intent. Answers the existing one when the pair already has a thread on the case. Not on your own case; not on a case that ended.

patch.summary: Corrects an active found, adoption or help case: photos, signs, story, and for an adoption its temperament and requirements. Only its publisher. Fields left out stay; a field the vertical has no use for is `validation_failed`. Never re-broadcasts. A lost case uses `editLost`.

get.summary: A case by its short code. The same URL answers more to the person responsible for it (`viewer`): claims, hidden pins, reporters’ numbers, the pending check-in, the withheld detail.

post.summary: Lost pets a found animal could be, each with its reasons. A person always confirms.
Publishes a found case. Same phone step as publishing a lost one.
«Es mío» on a found case. Never anonymous: it asks to take an animal.
The custodian’s verdict on an «es mío».
How a custodian ends a found case — or keeps looking and re-arms the hold clock.
A witness report with no case to attach to: kept and matched against later cases.

Publishes a help request — one to three needs in kind (`foster`, `transport`, `supplies`) for a pet the caller holds — with the phone step of every publish. With `pet_id: null` the pet is created and its owner link opens. Starts `unverified`, labelled so; nothing waits on review.

«Yo ayudo» on one need: the pledge row first, then the channel to the beneficiary. Needs a reachable number — a foster we cannot reach is not a foster — with the publish phone step. The beneficiary cannot pledge to their own request.
«Ya no puedo»: the pledger takes back an offer the beneficiary has not confirmed yet.

The beneficiary says what arrived: `confirmed` (the ride happened, the food arrived) or `declined`. Final either way. Confirmations that reach a need’s target cover it; every need covered closes the request as `covered`.
The beneficiary marks one need covered by their word — the way a «lo que puedan» need ends. Every need covered closes the request.
«Ya no necesita ayuda», with its reason. Pledgers with an open pledge are told. Pet and links are untouched.
«Lo vi»: a pin on a lost or found case. Visible at once; rate-limited per reporter. A repeated `client_id` on the same case answers the sighting it created, before any limit.
«Corregir»: moves the reporter’s own pin and its time, no new row. Only its reporter, only until `editable_until` (`created_at + 15 min`); the same distance and time checks as a new pin.

delete.summary: Deletes the reporter’s own pin. Only its reporter, only until `editable_until`; after that only the owner (hide) or moderation (remove) can take it off the map.

patch.summary: The owner stars a sighting as useful, or takes it off the public map.

post.summary: «Lo tengo» on a lost case. Creates the claim, then answers the channel to the owner. On a case archived less than 30 days ago it reactivates it first (decision #29).
`share.opened` (10 §5): someone opened a way to share the case — the system sheet, WhatsApp or a download. Anonymous; an unknown code is ignored. The client never waits for it.
Flags a publication for review. Anonymous; never hides an active case by itself.

Asks for a slot to store one prepared photo (JPEG, ≤ 1600 px): a short-lived presigned PUT signed with the photo’s SHA-256, scoped to what the photo is for and to who asks. The answer also carries the photo’s final URL; `upload` is null when that exact photo is already stored. A photo in a publish body that this caller did not upload for that purpose is refused.

get.summary: The in-app inbox, newest first: a copy of every notification sent to this account.

post.summary: Marks notifications as read: the ones named, or all of them.

get.summary: What an email button is: the case, the answer it carries and the state of the link. A safe answer («sigue perdida») is applied by this GET and comes back `applied`; a consequential one («ya apareció») never is — it comes back `confirm` until the POST. Opening a link again changes nothing (`used`); a question answered elsewhere is `already_answered`.

post.summary: The confirm page’s one button: applies the link’s answer — the same effect as answering the check-in in the app, with the defaults the app would ask for («¿quién te ayudó?» → `unknown`, the delete’s reason → `false_alarm`, «ya no necesita ayuda» → `need_ended`). Single use: a link that already answered, or a question answered elsewhere, answers its state and acts no more.

get.summary: The pets the caller is responsible for, for «¿Cuál se perdió?».
Every case the caller published, in any status, newest first.

post.summary: Publishes a lost case. Answers `phone_step: otp` when the number must be verified first: send the same body again with `otp_code`.

patch.summary: Corrects an active lost case: its photos, signs, and where and when it was last seen. Only the owner. Fields left out stay as they are. Never re-broadcasts: correcting the zone does not tell the neighbours again.

post.summary: Closes a lost case as reunited. Only its owner, and only while it is active.
Deletes an active lost case (false alarm, duplicate). Pet and owner link survive.
Reactivates an expired case: lost, found or a help request up to 30 days after it expired, an adoption listing up to 90 (adoption timelines are months).
The owner’s verdict on a «lo tengo». Confirming does not close the case: reunite does.

Answers the pending check-in. `reunited`, `delete` and `claim_confirmed` also end the case or the claim, exactly as their own endpoints would. An adoption listing answers `still_available`; its endings go through `recordAdoption` and `withdrawAdoption`. A help request answers `still_needed`; it ends through `closeHelp`.

get.summary: The countries the product runs in.
Open cases, newest first: near `lat`/`lng`, or the whole country when nothing is near.

device.name: device
device.description: Opaque, httpOnly, set by the API (docs/eng/api.md · Device identity). Identifies an anonymous reporter or claimant: authorizes correcting their own sighting, marks it `mine`, keys rate limits. Absent or unknown → the API issues a new one.
